# Abhishek Nadar — Digital Marketing Manager in Dubai

> Portfolio website of Abhishek Nadar, a Dubai-based Digital Marketing Manager with hands-on experience in SEO, Google Ads, PPC, lead generation, social media marketing, analytics, WordPress, web development, and creative marketing design.

This website presents Abhishek Nadar's professional background, education, services, work experience, measurable digital marketing performance, technical and marketing skills, portfolio projects, and contact information.

Key areas of expertise include SEO, local SEO, Google Ads, PPC, lead generation, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Meta Ads, Instagram Ads, Facebook Ads, WordPress, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Canva, Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, CapCut, Amazon marketing, content strategy, conversion optimization, and digital marketing reporting.

Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
